label: PF Backlog 458
title: ADR: coordination authority in the producer (supersede ADR-0002) + design/ops docs
body:
Child of the parallel-run-engine epic. Record the architecture reversal.

Scope: (1) new ADR superseding ADR-0002: "coordination authority (registry/lease) lives in the PRODUCER;
WorkerGrid is a runtime host; the coordinator is a fallback for producers without an assignment API"; (2) design
doc section 16 (parallel run engine) + update sections 2/5/6; (3) ops guide: /wg work, assignment lifecycle,
optimistic delivery, worker role; (4) note the producer-contract extension (claim/heartbeat/complete).

Descriptors: doc:docs/ARCHITECTURE-DECISIONS.md; doc:docs/WORKERGRID-DESIGN.md;
doc:docs/WORKER-SCHEDULER-OPERATIONS.md.

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; fast precheck PASS (docs-only). ADR-0003 added (ADR-0002 marked Superseded); design §16 (parallel run engine / two planes); ops guide updated. Closes EPIC BI-PF-0418.

decisions.decision: ADR-0003 accepted: assignment authority + delivery in PF; WorkerGrid = runtime host; coordinator = fallback (supersedes ADR-0002); codifies EPIC BI-PF-0418

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/api_docs.py, core/design_critic.py, core/design_tokens.py, core/finops.py

dashboard_impact.reason: Operator surface is /wg status + the PF API (assignments view); the dashboard is a separate surface and stays out of this slice
